purpose: Bind the result-independent validation, decision mapping, manuscript topology, and paper-only rendering for the prospective corrected DenseOn state-by-operator factorial before any factorial output exists.

visibility_at_freeze.note: The paper positions and every sign/interval branch were fixed before the Muon source checkpoint and before any factorial outcome.

input_contract.summary_manifest: Require status complete and exact scientific/implementation identities.
input_contract.inference: Recheck every point estimate and interval as finite, every interval as ordered, and every positive/negative/inconclusive decision from the frozen zero-exclusion rule.
input_contract.source_addressing: Verify the byte count and SHA-256 of every consumed summary table before rendering.

rendering_contract.abstract: Report all three final 50K-continuation endpoint contrasts and marginal intervals within the existing 200-word abstract limit; do not describe them as a decomposition of the primary-training gain.
rendering_contract.appendix: Report all three co-primary contrasts with their marginal, not simultaneous, intervals and retain every exact seed-task contrast and probe trajectory.
rendering_contract.main_conclusion: Propagate the same source-bound endpoint contrasts without implying within-level benefit, feature mediation, equivalence or effect dominance.
rendering_contract.main_mechanism: Report averaged source-state and continuation contrasts and their interaction with every original estimate, marginal 95% interval and decision; calibration matches the fixed probe, not the first realized shuffled-batch update.

result_blind_branching.no_positive_effect: Report supported negative contrasts or inconclusive intervals without treating nonsignificance as equivalence or absence of an effect.
result_blind_branching.operator_only: The continuation contrast is positive after averaging the fixed source states; this need not hold within both states or dominate other contrasts.
result_blind_branching.positive_interaction: The relative Muon continuation effect is more favorable from the Muon-reached state; this need not imply benefit from either state or full-trajectory co-adaptation.
result_blind_branching.weight_and_operator_without_interaction: Both averaged contrasts favor Muon, but their positive signs do not establish additivity; interpret the interaction separately.
result_blind_branching.weight_state_only: The source-state contrast is positive after averaging continuation operators; this does not establish dominance or equivalence of the other effects to zero.

complete_paper_layout_amendment.reason: The complete synthetic-results paper revealed an over-wide single-column factorial appendix table. Use a double-column table with the same three estimates, intervals, decisions and label. No numerical or inferential change.

paper_scope: The ACL manuscript is the sole publication deliverable. Summary CSVs and manifests are audit evidence rather than independent publication artifacts.
claim_boundary: These are final post-continuation contrasts for one fixed source pair and 50K horizon, not baseline-subtracted gains or a decomposition of primary training. The endpoint diagonal difference equals state plus operator, not state plus operator plus interaction. Neither averaged effects nor interaction alone establish within-level benefit, effect dominance, feature mediation or full-trajectory co-adaptation.
